title: BrewForgeRecipeDraft
description: The only shape the language model may return for UC-06 (Generate AI Recipe Draft). Sent as the json_schema of an OpenAI Structured Outputs call with strict=true. A response that does not conform is retried once and then rejected without being shown to the user (BR-07).

servingSizeMl.description: Finished volume in millilitres, if the model can infer it.

notes.description: Free text for the R&D Specialist only. Never shown in a lesson and never used by the validator.

steps.description: The preparation steps in intended order. Step numbering is 1-based and must be contiguous.

actionText.description: What the barista physically does, in the imperative.

equipmentClass.description: Must be one of the equipment_class values supplied in the prompt context. Null when the step uses no machine.

techniqueGate.description: The manual technique a trainer will confirm by observation, for example 'water at 90 C' or 'pour down the side of the cup'.

ingredients.description: May be empty for a step that consumes nothing, such as resting or cleaning.

ingredientCode.description: Must be one of the ingredient_code values supplied in the prompt context. The model must not invent a code.

dependsOnSteps.description: stepOrder values this step depends on. Must not contain this step's own stepOrder, and the resulting graph must be acyclic (BR-09).
